page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each of the 64 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating systems and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, ensuring steady data transfer rates for multi-tier architectures.

This hardware profile offers a high-density compute environment with dedicated resources, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring predictable CPU performance without the overhead of shared threads. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a tradeoff, positioning this instance for workloads reliant on network-attached storage. It is suited for general-purpose applications, web serving, database hosting, and CI/CD pipelines.
